study.name: Phase 2d: H5 Negative Text Treatment — Track 1 (brief-text-image)
study.description:
Tests 3 exclusion guidance levels (Minimal, Terse, Verbose) at the
carried-forward brief-text-image M/E with plus-hp library and T=0.0.

Minimal is the Phase 2c baseline (no exclusion text beyond basic
"Negative" label). Terse adds a brief "do not mark" list. Verbose
adds detailed per-type exclusion criteria with visual/key-difference/
test structure.

This is an OFAT simplification of the preregistered 3×3 M/E × H5
factorial: we test H5 at the carried-forward optimal M/E only.
See Decision 17.
